Thanks Elena — got the attachments and the CSV looks good. A couple of quick items so we can complete finance intake on our side:

1) PO reference: our system will create a PO after we finish vendor validation. I will loop in Procurement to generate PO-93472 for your first contract. For your invoices please include: PO-93472 in the invoice header and add the CSV field "remit_code" with the invoice id.

2) Micro-deposit: our payments team will initiate a $0.05 micro-deposit to the account on file to validate ACH ownership (this is standard). Can you confirm monitoring the Oceanview account for a small deposit sent within 48 hours?

3) Escrow/remit scenario: we have a small subset of vendors that route remits through our managed-escrow account for multi-entity settlements. For Helios, we anticipate direct remits; please let us know if you require an intermediary/escrow routing.

4) Compliance docs: we still need a completed vendor_onboarding_form (I'll attach a link) and a W-9 (if not already submitted).

I'll ask Marissa from FinOps to start the PO once she confirms vendor tax status.

Best,
David
Senior Program Manager, Finance Integrations
Redwood Inference
